# WHATWG Encoding Standard - single-byte index tables (feature 017)

The 27 index files of the legacy single-byte encodings of the WHATWG Encoding Standard, fetched from
`https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/index-<name>.txt` on 2026-11-17, unchanged. `tools/encodings/make-tables.py` turns
them into `core/src/text/single_byte_tables.inc`; `--check` verifies the generated file against these copies (CI lint).
ISO-8859-8-I shares ISO-8859-8's index; ISO-8859-1 (the editor's true Latin-1) is the identity on U+0000-U+00FF and has
no file. Licence: `LICENSE.txt` (BSD-3-Clause in source code, as the Standard states).
